description: This file contains JavaScript functions used for setting return values and updating related lists within a CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system, specifically for the Potentials module in vtiger CRM. It includes functions to set data for products, addresses, contacts, and tasks, and references external scripts and document elements.

methods.name: set_return(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets the parent product information in the opener window, depending on the form context.

methods.name: set_return_specific(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets specific potential IDs and names in the opener window form.

methods.name: add_data_to_relatedlist(entity_id,recordid)
methods.description: Updates the related list of contacts linked to an email, by navigating to a specific URL.

methods.name: set_return_address(potential_id, potential_name, account_id, account_name, bill_street, ship_street, bill_city, ship_city, bill_state, ship_state, bill_code, ship_code, bill_country, ship_country,bill_pobox,ship_pobox)
methods.description: Populates address and potential details in the opener window's form fields.

methods.name: set_return_contact(potential_id, potential_name, contact_id, contact_name)
methods.description: Sets contact and potential information in the opener window.

methods.name: set_return_todo(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets product information for a task in the opener window's form.

ctags.name: set_return_address
ctags.signature: (potential_id, potential_name, account_id, account_name, bill_street, ship_street, bill_city, ship_city, bill_state, ship_state, bill_code, ship_code, bill_country, ship_country,bill_pobox,ship_pobox)
